nodes.description: Abstract virtual function returning the address of the delegated implementation.
Payable receive() that forwards all value transfers to _fallback().
Payable fallback() that forwards unknown calls to _fallback().
Private delegatecall forwarder: reads implementation(), then assembly delegatecall with raw calldata.
Constant bytes32 storage slot (keccak256('org.zeppelinos.proxy.implementation')) holding the implementation address.
Empty constructor of UpgradeabilityProxy.
Overridden implementation(): sloads the implementation address from implementationPosition.
Internal setter that writes newImplementation into the implementation storage slot via sstore.
Internal upgrade routine: requires new != current, then setImplementation and emits Upgraded.
Constant bytes32 storage slot (keccak256('org.zeppelinos.proxy.owner')) holding the proxy owner.
Constructor that establishes msg.sender as the initial proxy owner.
Authorization modifier requiring msg.sender == proxyOwner().
View function sloading the owner address from proxyOwnerPosition.
Internal setter writing the owner address into the owner storage slot via sstore.
Owner-only function that transfers proxy ownership to newOwner.
Owner-only function delegating to _upgradeTo(implementation).
Owner-only payable function: upgradeTo then low-level address(this).call{value:msg.value}(data).
Caller-controlled address used for ownership and authorization checks.
Assembly delegatecall(gas(), _impl, ptr, calldatasize(), 0, 0) executing foreign code in proxy storage context.
Low-level address(this).call{value: msg.value}(data) with attacker-influenced calldata after an upgrade.
Assembly sstore writing the implementation address to the dedicated storage slot.
Assembly sstore writing the proxy owner address to the dedicated storage slot.
Local address holding the result of implementation(), used as delegatecall target.
Address parameter of setImplementation written to the implementation slot.
Address parameter of _upgradeTo representing the new implementation.
Local cache of implementation() used in the inequality require.
Address parameter of setUpgradabilityOwner written to the owner slot.
Address parameter for the new owner in transferProxyOwnership.
Address parameter of upgradeTo forwarded to _upgradeTo.
Address parameter of upgradeToAndCall forwarded to upgradeTo.
Arbitrary bytes payload used as calldata for the post-upgrade low-level call.
Boolean result of the low-level self call, checked with require.
Local bytes32 loaded from the implementationPosition constant before sload.
Local bytes32 loaded from the proxyOwnerPosition constant before sload.

edges.reason: receive() unconditionally forwards execution to _fallback().
fallback() unconditionally forwards execution to _fallback().
_fallback() resolves the delegatecall target by calling implementation().
_impl (from implementation()) is supplied as the delegatecall target.
_fallback() delegatecalls into attacker-influenceable implementation code with full proxy storage and value.
implementation() sloads from the implementationPosition slot.
implementationPosition is copied into the local position variable.
setImplementation uses implementationPosition as the sstore slot.
newImplementation parameter is the value written by the sstore operation.
setImplementation performs the assembly sstore of the implementation address.
newImplementation from _upgradeTo is forwarded into setImplementation.
The value returned by implementation() is stored in currentImplementation.
_upgradeTo calls implementation() to read the current implementation.
_upgradeTo calls setImplementation to persist the new address.
newImplementation parameter drives the require check and the storage update in _upgradeTo.
proxyOwner() sloads from the proxyOwnerPosition slot.
proxyOwnerPosition is copied into the local position variable.
setUpgradabilityOwner uses proxyOwnerPosition as the sstore slot.
newProxyOwner parameter is the value written by the sstore operation.
setUpgradabilityOwner performs the assembly sstore of the owner address.
onlyProxyOwner gates execution on msg.sender == proxyOwner().
The OwnedUpgradabilityProxy constructor sets the initial owner to msg.sender.
msg.sender flows into setUpgradabilityOwner during construction, granting ownership.
transferProxyOwnership is guarded by the onlyProxyOwner modifier.
upgradeTo is guarded by the onlyProxyOwner modifier.
upgradeToAndCall is guarded by the onlyProxyOwner modifier.
newOwner parameter is used to transfer proxy ownership.
transferProxyOwnership calls setUpgradabilityOwner to persist the new owner.
The implementation parameter of upgradeTo is passed to _upgradeTo.
upgradeTo delegates the actual upgrade to _upgradeTo.
upgradeToAndCall passes its implementation parameter into upgradeTo.
The data parameter becomes the calldata of the low-level call.
upgradeToAndCall performs an external low-level call with value and user-supplied calldata after upgrading.
The success flag from the low-level call is verified with require in upgradeToAndCall.

normalization_plan.reason: _impl exists only to feed the delegatecall target and should be absorbed into the delegatecall unsafe_operation.
newImplementation is a transient parameter of setImplementation and normalizes into that core function.
newImplementation is a transient parameter of _upgradeTo and normalizes into that core function.
currentImplementation is a temporary read of implementation() inside _upgradeTo.
newProxyOwner is a transient parameter of setUpgradabilityOwner and normalizes into that core function.
newOwner is a transient parameter of transferProxyOwnership and normalizes into that core function.
implementation is a transient parameter of upgradeTo and normalizes into that core function.
implementation is a transient parameter of upgradeToAndCall passed straight into upgradeTo.
data is an untrusted calldata parameter consumed by the low-level call unsafe_operation.
success is a transient local of upgradeToAndCall and normalizes into that core function.
position is a transient local used only by implementation() for the sload.
position is a transient local used only by proxyOwner() for the sload.
